webster.text: Giving admonition; warning; instructing by way of caution.

example.quote: It would be unjustifiable delicacy, nevertheless, to pass by so portentous a claim, proceeding from so high an authority, without a monitory notice of the fatal tendencies with which it would be pregnant.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
